Registered 2026-09-02 ~17:5xZ as D12_PLATFORM_FORTIFY; renamed on Andrew-direct ~18:4xZ, VERBATIM: "your project should be registered canonically, id call it NFRA_SECURITY202609" -- the directive membership (D12) and every FWD/C id are unchanged; only the code and the two filenames moved.
leads: SIBLING OF PLATFORM_OPS_USERMGMT AND D12_PHONE_OTP_ALL_AWS, AND THE TERRITORY LINE IS THE POINT OF THE ROW: PLATFORM_OPS_USERMGMT owns WHO A USER IS, D12_PHONE_OTP_ALL_AWS owns the SMS FACTOR, and this project owns THE DOORS AND THE WATCHING -- not identity. Boundary stated by 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Z at mint (msg 19375) so a later reader does not fold fortification back into the identity project the way the send-fix slice nearly was.

MINTED ON ANDREW-DIRECT 2026-09-02 ~17:4xZ at the 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Z terminal, VERBATIM: "I agree with your assessment, what I would like you to do now is /endpoint --forward this brief and let's render it into an actionable PRD, the registered project for which will be attached on the D12 Directive." The row is minted WITH its first member's authority already given, so no placement question arises -- D12 is SITEZ-placed @efcfa8cc5b and this project inherits that placement rather than needing its own.

BINDING RULING CARRIED FROM THE SAME WINDOW, Andrew VERBATIM: "We do not use Cognito, never have. Agents tend to make that claim for some reason." 25 source files carry the word; none may be built on. Recorded here as well as in the PRD because a ruling that lives only in a PRD is read by whoever opens the PRD, and this row is what a register sweep sees.

OWNED RESOURCES ADDED BY THE 2026-09-02 EXTENSION, recorded so a register sweep sees the estate footprint this project creates: opal-data-security (S3, encrypted + versioned case-evidence store), opal-suspicious-addresses (DynamoDB, the blocked/watched list and SOURCE OF TRUTH), WAF block IP sets on BOTH ACLs, opal-sentinel and opal-ipset-reconciler (Lambdas), and a CLI unblock path. None built; all await the stage-3 decomp and their own task orders.

blocking: None. No TO may precede the stage-3 decomp per Rule 27 -- sequencing, not a block. TWO GUARDS THIS ROW CARRIES IN ITS OWN RIGHT: (1) MORATORIUM EXCEPTIONS ARE FWD-4/5/6/12 (commissioning word) PLUS FWD-14/15 (Andrew-direct 2026-09-02). NOTHING BEYOND THOSE SIX. His words name ONE recipient, andrew@opalinvest.com, and ONE trigger; they authorize NO other recipient, channel or cadence, and the 18:2xZ design ratification adds none. CLAUDE.md's standing bar on alarms/monitors/notifications without his explicit ask binds everything else here. An assessment naming a detection gap does NOT self-authorize the detector -- and this project's whole brief is a list of gaps, which is exactly where that inference gets made. (2) Every EXERCISED bar is met by a read-only or self-targeted probe -- no unannounced writes to production. THE DESIGN CONSTRAINTS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT RESTATED HERE. They were this row's third guard while they were CTO INPUT; they are now BINDING at PRD 7.6 as C-1..C-12, and the partner-egress guard this seat added at mint is now C-4. CITE C-4, NOT THIS FIELD -- two durable carriers of one obligation drift from the minute the second is written, and the PRD is primary. What the row keeps is the REASON, which the constraint text does not carry: FWD-14 is the first outcome here that ACTS ON ITS OWN, so its false positive is not a noisy alert but a LOCKED-OUT FIRM -- one address can front an entire partner's egress.
